name: Heterocyclic Chemistry
summary: Structure, reactivity and synthesis of heterocycles, the ring systems found in most drugs and many materials.

topics.name: Pyridines and diazines: structure and reactivity
Five-membered heteroaromatics: pyrrole, furan and thiophene
Azoles: imidazole, oxazole, thiazole and triazoles
Classic ring syntheses (Hantzsch, Fischer indole, Paal-Knorr)
Heterocycles in drugs, dyes and natural products
